units.rawText: Gah... Tch... My old wounds are flaring up. They sting a bit on rainy days. No need for you to worry about them, Professor.

units.rawText: I can have the damaged parts replaced at the medical Department? Thank you for the offer, but I fear that without the pain to remind me of my past, I would fall into the mires of complacency…

units.rawText: You've given me sanctuary, and I have little to fear here at the Oasis. This almost self-destructive way of reminding myself has no doubt lost its original meaning... but I do not want to forget that meaning.

units.rawText: And... if I was to have something I desire even less to forget, how am I to create a mark to remind myself of that…
